prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, cool ash-grey hair styled in braided, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a lead hammer head, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a lead miniature anvil, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished jade.

LEFT Body Art: full body polished jade-green stone fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale-green cloudy vein striations flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere.
